objective_pt: Estruturar uma apresentação curta com conectivos (first, moving on, to sum up), descrever um gráfico e responder a perguntas.

teacher.goal_pt: Falar sobre experiências com apresentações e aquecer com uma abertura clara.
prompts: When was the last time you gave a presentation?
Do you get nervous when you speak in public?
watchFor: "Make a presentation" é aceitável, mas "give a presentation" é mais comum.
Dizer "explain you" em vez de "explain to you".

exercises.prompt: Today I'd like to walk you through our new idea.
accepted: Today I'd like to walk you through our new idea.
Today I would like to walk you through our new idea.

exercises.explanation_pt: "Resume" é falso cognato: significa retomar, continuar. "Resumir" é "summarize" (ou "sum up").

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Deixa eu te explicar a ideia."
accepted: Let me explain the idea to you
Let me explain the idea
Let me explain the idea to you guys
Let me walk you through the idea
Let me tell you about the idea
Let me run you through the idea
Let me explain my idea to you
Let me explain my idea

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Explain" pede "to" antes da pessoa: "explain the idea to you". "Explain you" é tradução literal de "te explicar".
commonErrors.correction_en: Let me explain the idea to you.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender conectivos de apresentação e verbos para descrever números (rise, drop, level off).
prompts: How would you describe your company's sales this year?
How do you move from one slide to the next?
watchFor: Dizer "the graphic shows"; o natural é "the chart" ou "the graph shows".

exercises.example_en: To sum up, the project is on time and under budget.
Sales rose sharply in the second quarter.
After that, the numbers levelled off.

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Say it in English: "Como vocês podem ver no gráfico, as vendas subiram 10%."
accepted: As you can see in the chart, sales rose by 10%
As you can see on the chart, sales rose by 10%
As you can see in the chart, sales went up by 10%
As you can see in the graph, sales rose by 10%
As you can see on the graph, sales went up by 10%
As you can see in the chart, sales increased by 10%
As you can see from the chart, sales increased by 10%
As you can see in the chart, sales rose 10%
As you can see in the chart, sales went up 10%
As you can see in the chart, sales increased by ten percent
As you can see in the chart, sales rose by ten percent
As you can see in the chart, sales went up by ten percent

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês, gráfico de dados é "chart" ou "graph". "Graphic" é uma imagem ou arte visual.
commonErrors.correction_en: As you can see in the chart, sales rose by 10%.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Raise" precisa de objeto (alguém aumenta algo). Quando o número sobe sozinho, use "rise" (rose) ou "go up" (went up).

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar a pausa e a ênfase nas palavras-chave, a tônica de "percent" e o "-ed" dos verbos de tendência.
prompts: Say "twenty percent". Where is the stress in "percent"?
Say "dropped" and "started". Do they end the same way?
watchFor: Falar "percent" com tônica no começo; é per-CENT.
Pronunciar "dropped" como "drop-ED"; o "-ed" aqui soa como "t".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. "Dropped" ends with a "t" sound, and "percent" is per-CENT.
exercises.prompt: Our costs dropped by fifteen percent.
accepted: Our costs dropped by fifteen percent.
Our costs dropped by 15 percent.
Our costs dropped by 15%.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Não esqueça o "-ed" do passado. Em "dropped" ele soa como "t": "dropt".
commonErrors.correction_en: Our costs dropped by fifteen percent.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. Pause briefly after "So" and stress "key".
exercises.prompt: So, the key takeaway is simple: we need more time.
accepted: So, the key takeaway is simple: we need more time.

exercises.instruction_pt: In which word does "-ed" add an extra syllable?
exercises.explanation_pt: O "-ed" só vira sílaba extra ("id") depois de "t" ou "d": "star-ted". Em "dropped" e "increased" ele soa como "t", sem sílaba nova.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender os conectivos que organizam uma apresentação e responder a perguntas da plateia.
prompts: What does a presenter mean by "moving on"?
What do you say when you don't know the answer to a question?
watchFor: Responder "Good question" e depois não responder; treinar "I'll get back to you on that".
Dizer "I don't know" seco demais; em apresentações, suavizar.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. What is the presenter doing?
exercises.listen: Right, that's all on costs. Moving on to the timeline, we're planning to launch in March.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Moving on to..." sinaliza a passagem para um novo tópico: dos custos para o cronograma.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. You don't know the answer right now. Say you'll check and get back to them.
exercises.listen: How much will the second phase cost?
accepted: I'm not sure, but I'll get back to you on that
I'll get back to you on that
Good question. I'll get back to you on that
I don't have that number right now, but I'll get back to you
I'm not sure. Let me check and get back to you
Let me check and get back to you
I'll have to check and get back to you
I need to check that. I'll get back to you
I'll check and let you know
Let me check and let you know
I don't know yet, but I'll find out and let you know

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Te dou um retorno" em inglês é "I'll get back to you". "Return to you" soa como voltar fisicamente até a pessoa.
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll check and get back to you on that.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Dar um retorno" não se traduz palavra por palavra. Diga "I'll get back to you" ou "I'll let you know".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll get back to you on that.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen and answer: what happened to sales after the spike?
exercises.listen: Sales rose sharply in January, and after that they levelled off.
accepted: They levelled off
They leveled off
Sales levelled off
Sales leveled off
They stayed the same
They stayed stable
They became stable
They stabilized
They stopped growing
They stayed more or less the same
After that, they levelled off
After that, they leveled off

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Level off" não é cair: é parar de subir e ficar estável.

teacher.goal_pt: Fazer uma mini-apresentação de 1 minuto com começo, meio e fim, usando conectivos.
prompts: Can you present one idea to improve your team's work?
watchFor: Começar com "I will talk about..." sem contexto; incentivar "Today I'd like to...".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Primeiro, vou falar sobre o problema e depois vou mostrar a solução."
accepted: First, I'll talk about the problem and then I'll show the solution
First, I'll talk about the problem and then I'll show you the solution
First, I'm going to talk about the problem and then I'll show you the solution
First, I'm going to talk about the problem and then show you the solution
First, I'll talk about the problem, and then I'll present the solution
First of all, I'll talk about the problem and then I'll show you the solution
First, I'll go over the problem and then I'll show you the solution
First, I'll talk about the problem and after that I'll show you the solution

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Falar sobre" é "talk about", sem outra preposição.
commonErrors.correction_en: First, I'll talk about the problem and then I'll show you the solution.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Depois" sozinho, para ordenar etapas, é "then" ou "after that". "After I show" muda o sentido para "depois que eu mostrar".
commonErrors.correction_en: First, I'll talk about the problem and then I'll show you the solution.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Resumindo, essa mudança vai nos economizar tempo e dinheiro."
accepted: To sum up, this change will save us time and money
To sum up, this change is going to save us time and money
In short, this change will save us time and money
To summarize, this change will save us time and money
To summarise, this change will save us time and money
In summary, this change will save us time and money
So, to sum up, this change will save us time and money
To sum up, this change will save us both time and money

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Resume" significa retomar. Para "resumindo" use "to sum up", "to summarize" ou "in short".
commonErrors.correction_en: To sum up, this change will save us time and money.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Economizar tempo e dinheiro" é "save time and money". "Economize" existe, mas é raro e formal.
commonErrors.correction_en: This change will save us time and money.

exercises.instruction_pt: Put the words in order to invite questions.
accepted: I'd be happy to answer any questions you have

exercises.instruction_pt: Give a one-minute presentation of an idea to improve something at work or at home.
exercises.prompt_en: You've got one minute. What's your idea, why does it matter, and what should we do next?
guidelines_pt: Open: "Today I'd like to talk about..."
Use signposts: "First...", "Moving on to...", "As you can see..."
Close: "To sum up..." and invite questions.

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar conectivos, verbos de tendência e os falsos cognatos "resume" e "graphic".
prompts: How do you start a presentation?
How do you describe a number that goes down a little?

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Houve uma pequena queda em abril."
accepted: There was a slight drop in April
There was a small drop in April
There was a slight decrease in April
There was a small decrease in April
There was a slight fall in April
There was a small dip in April
There was a slight dip in April

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Houve" em inglês é "there was". "Had" (teve) precisa de um sujeito: "We had a slight drop".
commonErrors.correction_en: There was a slight drop in April.
There was a slight drop in April.

accepted: rose
went up
increased
fell
dropped
went down
decreased

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Raise" precisa de objeto: "They raised prices". Sem objeto, use "rose" ou "went up".

exercises.instruction_pt: Which phrase do you use to introduce the last point?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Finally" introduz o último ponto. "At the end" pede complemento ("at the end of the year"), e "in the final" não existe nesse sentido.

exercises.instruction_pt: To finish, repeat the closing line.
exercises.prompt: Thank you for your attention. Are there any questions?
accepted: Thank you for your attention. Are there any questions?
Thanks for your attention. Are there any questions?
Thank you for your attention. Any questions?
